title: A probability forecast can overshoot
hook: Two stated cases: explore the gap between a stated forecast and observed frequency.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the gap between a stated forecast and observed frequency affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the gap between a stated forecast and observed frequency in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy forecast claims probability 0.4; 20 of 100 matched it. What is claimed probability minus observed share?
